method: Visual-only classification of clothing-blind.png followed by inspection of ambiguous individual B-label PNGs. Classes were inferred from cloth quality, fur, ornament, aprons, patches, robes, and visible occupational accessories. No metadata or ground truth was read; no class balancing was used. Confidence is a subjective 0-to-1 estimate.
limitations: Only the bottom 80 pixels of each bust are visible. Faces and most headwear are excluded. Labour and poor_servant can share coarse patched cloth; gentry and merchant can share fine cloth and fur. Plain brown garments lack decisive religious insignia. Repeated-looking clothing was judged consistently but cannot establish social class with certainty.
